title: Pointwise etale perversities and localization of perverse extension
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $n\geq1$, $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, and $X$ a Noetherian scheme with $\ell$ invertible [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Use ordinary small etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For a point $x$, $R\Gamma_x$ means extraordinary restriction to the residue field after localization, with geometric fibres computed on the strict localization [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex]. Let $p:|X|\to\mathbf Z$ be nondecreasing under specialization. The conditions
$$D^{\leq p}=\{M\in D^+:H^a(M|_{\bar x})=0\text{ for }a>p(x)\},\qquad D^{\geq p}=\{M\in D^+:H^a(R\Gamma_{\bar x}M)=0\text{ for }a<p(x)\}$$
define a t-structure on $D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$. Denote its heart by $\operatorname{Perv}^p(X)$ and its upper truncation by $\tau_{\leq p}$.

A pseudo-open immersion $f:Y\to X$ means a scheme morphism inducing a homeomorphism onto its image and an isomorphism $f^{-1}\mathcal O_X\cong\mathcal O_Y$. For such $f$ between Noetherian schemes, $f^*$ is t-exact for $p$ and $p\circ f$, and $Rf_*$ preserves the lower class. The functor
$$f_*^p=\tau_{\leq p}Rf_*:\operatorname{Perv}^{p\circ f}(Y)\to\operatorname{Perv}^p(X)$$
is a fully faithful right adjoint of $f^*$, its counit $f^*f_*^p\to\mathrm{id}$ is an isomorphism, and $f_*^p g_*^{p\circ f}\cong(fg)_*^p$ for composable pseudo-open immersions. These identifications respect units and counits.

For etale restriction and for localization or strict localization, pullback is t-exact for the pulled-back function, and perverse extension from a generic point of a normal integral scheme commutes with that restriction (using the generic point of the resulting normal integral scheme). Here etale and strict localization are [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and normal integral means [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. In particular, let $X$ be local strictly henselian with closed point $x$, let $g:U=X-\{x\}\hookrightarrow X$, and let $L\in\operatorname{Perv}^{p|_U}(U)$. If $L$ is also ordinarily bounded above by $p(x)$, then
$$g_*^pL\cong\tau^{\mathrm{ord}}_{\leq p(x)}Rg_*L.$$
The ordinary truncation does not alter the restriction to $U$, and this isomorphism is compatible with the adjunction map to $Rg_*L$.
